```{r}
library(readr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggprism)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r, fig.height=20, fig.width=20}
# Load necessary data: abundance data and metadata
KO_file <- "picrust2_pipeline_output/KO_metagenome_out/pred_metagenome_unstrat.tsv"
pathways_file <- "picrust2_pipeline_output/pathways_out/path_abun_unstrat.tsv"
EC_file <- "picrust2_pipeline_output/EC_metagenome_out/pred_metagenome_unstrat_descrip.tsv"


metadata <- read_delim(
    "../Pediatric_cohort/Qiime2/Files_For_Phyloseq/metadata_phyloseq.tsv",
    delim = "\t",
    escape_double = FALSE,
    trim_ws = TRUE
)

metadata <- metadata %>% as.data.frame() %>% filter(Type %in% c("Plaque", "Abscess"))



# Run ggpicrust2 with input data
pathway_file_read <- read_delim(
    pathways_file,
    delim = "\t",
    escape_double = FALSE,
    trim_ws = TRUE
    ) %>% as.data.frame()  
cols_to_keep <- c("pathway",  metadata$SampleID)
pathway_file_read <- pathway_file_read[, cols_to_keep]

pathway_results <- ggpicrust2(data = pathway_file_read,
                                 metadata = metadata,
                                 group = "Type",
                                 pathway = "MetaCyc",
                                 daa_method = "LinDA",
                                 ko_to_kegg = FALSE,
                                 p_values_bar = TRUE)

# Access the plot and results dataframe for the first DA method
pathway_results[[1]]$plot
pathway_results[[2]]$results


KO_file_read <- read_delim(
    KO_file,
    delim = "\t",
    escape_double = FALSE,
    trim_ws = TRUE
    ) %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  column_to_rownames(var="function") %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(metadata$SampleID)) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var="function")

KO_results <- ggpicrust2(data = KO_file_read,
                                 metadata = metadata,
                                 group = "Type",
                                 pathway = "KO",
                                 daa_method = "LinDA",
                                 order = "group",
                                 ko_to_kegg = FALSE,
                                 p_values_bar = FALSE, 
                                 p.adjust = "BH", 
                                 reference = "Abscess", 
                                 x_lab = "feature")



EC_file_read <- read_delim(
    EC_file,
    delim = "\t",
    escape_double = FALSE,
    trim_ws = TRUE
    ) %>% as.data.frame() 
cols_to_keep <- c("function", "description",  metadata$SampleID)
EC_file_read <- EC_file_read[, cols_to_keep]

EC_results <- ggpicrust2(data = EC_file_read,
                                 metadata = metadata,
                                 group = "Type",
                                 pathway = "EC",
                                 daa_method = "LinDA",
                                 order = "group",
                                 ko_to_kegg = TRUE,
                                 p_values_bar = FALSE, 
                                 p.adjust = "BH", 
                                 reference = "Abscess")

```






# Just doing this myself
```{r}
# Load necessary data: abundance data and metadata
KO_file <- "picrust2_pipeline_output/KO_metagenome_out/pred_metagenome_unstrat_descrip.tsv"
EC_file <- "picrust2_pipeline_output/EC_metagenome_out/pred_metagenome_unstrat_descrip.tsv"
pathways_file <- "picrust2_pipeline_output/pathways_out/path_abun_unstrat_descrip.tsv"


metadata <- read_delim(
    "../Pediatric_cohort/Qiime2/Files_For_Phyloseq/metadata_phyloseq.tsv",
    delim = "\t",
    escape_double = FALSE,
    trim_ws = TRUE
)

metadata <- metadata %>% as.data.frame() %>% filter(Type %in% c("Plaque", "Abscess")) 


KO_file_read <- read_delim(
    KO_file,
    delim = "\t",
    escape_double = FALSE,
    trim_ws = TRUE
    ) %>% as.data.frame()  %>%
    rename_with(~ ifelse(.x == "function", "func", .x)) %>%
    mutate(funct = paste(func, description, sep = "_")) %>%
    dplyr::select(-description, -func) %>%
    column_to_rownames(var="funct") %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(metadata$SampleID)) 


EC_file_read <- read_delim(
    EC_file,
    delim = "\t",
    escape_double = FALSE,
    trim_ws = TRUE
    ) %>% as.data.frame() %>%
    rename_with(~ ifelse(.x == "function", "func", .x)) %>%
    mutate(funct = paste(func, description, sep = "_")) %>%
    dplyr::select(-description, -func)%>%
    column_to_rownames(var="funct") %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(metadata$SampleID))

pathway_file_read <- read_delim(
    pathways_file,
    delim = "\t",
    escape_double = FALSE,
    trim_ws = TRUE
    ) %>% as.data.frame()  %>%
    dplyr::mutate(funct = paste(pathway, description, sep = "_")) %>%
    dplyr::select(-description, -pathway)%>%
    column_to_rownames(var="funct") %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(metadata$SampleID)) 


library(Maaslin2)
maaslin2_pathway <- Maaslin2(input_data = pathway_file_read,
                     input_metadata = metadata,
                     fixed_effects = "Type",
                     output = "test",
                     normalization = "CLR",
                     transform = "NONE")

res <- fit_data$results %>% filter(qval < .05)

#Aldex2
library(ALDEx2)
# Define grouping variable
group <- metadata$Type

# ALDEx2 analysis
x <- aldex.clr(pathway_file_read, group, mc.samples = 128, denom = "all", verbose = TRUE)
res <- aldex.ttest(x, paired.test = FALSE)
effect <- aldex.effect(x)

# Merge results
final_results <- cbind(res, effect)

```
